lines: Aah ko chahiye ek umr asar hone tak
couplets.en: A sigh takes a lifetime to be felt.

lines: Kaun jeeta hai teri zulf ke sar hone tak
couplets.en: Who lives long enough to win a single lock of your hair?

lines: Aashiqi sabr talab aur tamanna betaab
couplets.en: Love asks for patience, and longing cannot wait.

lines: Dil ka kya rang karun khoon-e-jigar hone tak
couplets.en: What hue shall I give my heart until my grief runs to blood?

lines: Hum ne maana ke taghaful na karoge lekin
couplets.en: I grant that you will turn your attention to me, but.

lines: Khaak ho jaayenge hum tum ko khabar hone tak
couplets.en: I will be dust by the time you hear of me.
